title: Rolling Clock
description: A clock app where each of the six digits is its own vertical carousel, rolling forward every second, with a 12/24-hour switch and an alarms list.
steps: Six vertical `loop` carousels hold 3, 10, 6, 10, 6 and 10 digits, with `scrollEnabled={false}` because the clock moves them, not your finger.
Each change calls `next({ count })` with the forward distance from `getCurrentIndex()`, so 9 rolls on to 0 and 23 to 00 without turning back.
`animation` is a 650 ms timing on an overshooting bezier (0.34, 1.56, 0.64, 1), and `itemAnimation` moves each digit one tile while it shrinks to 0.6 and fades.
